# Prakhar India Real Estate & Construction

> Verified real estate developer, turnkey civil construction company, and licensed manpower supplier operating across Uttar Pradesh since 2014.

## Brand Identity & Registered Entity
- **Legal Entity Name:** Prakhar Infradevelopers Private Limited (CIN: U70102UP2015PTC072853 · Registered August 21, 2015)
- **Public Brand Display:** PRAKHAR INDIA / Prakhar India (distinct from Prakhar Architecture design firm)
- **Registered Office (Varanasi):** 318/1, Sanjay Nagar Colony, Nakkhighat, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh 221007, India
- **Purvanchal Operations Office (Mirzapur):** Plot No. 14, Industrial Area, Mirzapur City, Uttar Pradesh 231001, India

## Core Service Divisions (2026 Verified Benchmarks)
1. **Turnkey House Construction in Varanasi & UP (`https://prakharind.com/turnkey-house-construction-varanasi/` & `https://prakharind.com/pages/construction.html`)**
   - Standard Turnkey: ₹1,450 / sq.ft
   - Executive / Premium Residence: ₹1,850 / sq.ft
   - Luxury Architectural Build: ₹2,400+ / sq.ft
   - Includes 2D/3D CAD & structural drawings, Fe-550D TATA Tiscon / JSW steel, ACC / UltraTech cement, stage-wise milestone billing, and a 10-year structural warranty.
2. **Labour-Only Civil Contractor / Thekedar (`https://prakharind.com/pages/makan-banane-wala-thekedar.html`)**
   - Skilled civil labour contracting (grey structure to finishing): ₹220 – ₹320 / sq.ft across UP.
3. **UP-RERA & Section 143/80 Verified Freehold Plots (`https://prakharind.com/pages/plots-in-uttar-pradesh.html`)**
   - Mirzapur Enclaves (`https://prakharind.com/pages/plots-in-mirzapur.html` & `https://prakharind.com/pages/real-estate-mirzapur.html`): Chunar industrial corridor from ₹650/sq.ft; Shastri Bridge & Natwa residential plots from ₹950–₹1,850/sq.ft; Vindhyachal commercial land ₹1,800–₹4,500/sq.ft.
   - Lucknow Plots (`https://prakharind.com/pages/plots-in-lucknow.html`): Sultanpur Road, Kisan Path, Raebareli Road (SGPGI), Gomti Nagar Extension.
4. **Civil & Industrial Manpower Supply (`https://prakharind.com/pages/manpower.html` & `https://prakharind.com/pages/manpower-chandauli.html`)**
   - Trained masons, bar-benders, shuttering carpenters, electricians, factory helpers, and logistics workforce deployed across Mirzapur, Chandauli (Mughalsarai), Varanasi, Prayagraj, and UP industrial belts.
5. **Residential & Commercial Leasing in Lucknow (`https://prakharind.com/pages/flats-for-rent-lucknow.html` & `https://prakharind.com/pages/office-space-for-rent-lucknow.html`)**
   - Bare-shell / warm-shell commercial spaces from ₹32–₹48/sq.ft and plug-and-play furnished IT offices ₹70–₹110/sq.ft in Vibhuti Khand & Shaheed Path.
